g.text: clientRef is generated on the phone when the report
is created, so a report queued offline and retried
on reconnect is stored once, not duplicated (I3).
No GPS position is stored, per the privacy requirement.
report, snapped to the trail line, never shown with
the author. A nullable column, so adding it later is
non-breaking. Needs the privacy requirement reworded.
Attendee lists are visible only to other
